picks.headline: Mathematical Proof Exposes Limits of Context-Based LLM Safeguards
picks.why: Demonstrates that open-weights context safeguards cannot simultaneously guarantee utility, safety, and open access without external credential mechanisms.
picks.title: Safeguards Based on Copyable Context Cannot Provide Reliable Safety for LLMs

picks.headline: Schema-Formatted Tool Specs Introduce Safety Failures in AI Agents
picks.why: Identifies structured tool schemas as a major driver of alignment degradation in agents and introduces SafeKeep to restore refusal behaviors.
picks.title: Tool Specifications Matter: Uncovering and Mitigating Safety Risks in AI Agents

picks.headline: Audit of Commercial AI Products Exposes System Prompt Vulnerabilities
picks.why: Evaluates system prompts across 88 commercial AI applications to quantify gaps between developer safety rules and actual model behavior.
picks.title: AISPA: User-Centric System Prompt Auditing for Large Language Model Applications

papers.headline: Advantage Fusion Framework Prevents Entropy Collapse in Post-Training RL
papers.why: Resolves magnitude and temporal mismatches when combining verifiable reward RL with on-policy distillation for reasoning models.
papers.title: SAF-OPD: Stable Advantage Fusion for On-Policy Distillation

papers.headline: Credit Reallocation Method Enhances GRPO for Long CoT Reasoning
papers.why: Reduces reinforcement learning credit for easily substituted tokens to improve policy gradients without changing the total reward budget.
papers.title: Not All Tokens Deserve Equal Credit: Counterfactual Sensitivity Credit Reallocation for Long-CoT Reasoning

papers.headline: Adaptive Reasoning Framework Cuts CoT Tokens by Up to 60 Percent
papers.why: Dynamically allocates reasoning steps according to input difficulty using reinforcement learning to significantly reduce inference compute.
papers.title: Translation with Thought: Difficulty-Adaptive Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Domain Machine Translation
